title: Observed bedside responsiveness from causal pre-assessment EEG
scientific_question: How accurately can immediately preceding EEG estimate the recorded bedside responsiveness category at each authentic assessment?
participant_inputs: Complete two-channel125Hz waveform for30seconds (7,500 values when fully sampled), units, time offsets and artifact/missingness masks. No MOAA/S/SoC columns, dose, clinical event codes, procedure-progress features or patient-identifying metadata in the neural-only main arm.
known_answer: The recorded MOAA/S response category under its authentic released scale and assessment protocol. This is behavioral responsiveness, not direct proof of consciousness or an anesthetic dose recommendation.

complete_scope.question: Estimate the observed bedside responsiveness category at each documented MOAA/S assessment from the immediately preceding EEG.
complete_scope.one_target: The recorded MOAA/S response category under its authentic released scale and assessment protocol. This is behavioral responsiveness, not direct proof of consciousness or an anesthetic dose recommendation.
complete_scope.unit: Every documented assessment in every recording; the main packet is the fixed30-second EEG interval ending before the assessment begins. Exact assessment onset/offset and scale levels require the original dictionary.
complete_scope.input: Complete two-channel125Hz waveform for30seconds (7,500 values when fully sampled), units, time offsets and artifact/missingness masks. No MOAA/S/SoC columns, dose, clinical event codes, procedure-progress features or patient-identifying metadata in the neural-only main arm.
complete_scope.complete_compact_representation: The complete declared30-second raw waveform is already finite; do not truncate it or omit difficult assessments for context fit. A separately labelled40-pEEG common-table analysis may cover the identical preceding window, but requires audited causal preprocessing and cannot claim raw/native equivalence. All171 recordings and all7,328 reported assessment slots must reconcile before final counts.
complete_scope.measurement_grid_and_missingness: Assessment is clinically/event driven, not an unbiased uniform sample of time. Preserve every assessment time, repeated measurements, ambiguous/missing ratings, incomplete history and artifact status. Do not forward-fill target labels, invent unobserved consciousness states or interpolate responsiveness continuously. Define evaluable/missing denominators before model outcomes.
complete_scope.heldout: Group by authentic person identity across all repeated recordings/procedures. Do not equate171 recordings with171 independent people. Use outer grouped folds with all temporally overlapping windows in one group, inner group tuning, and report procedure type/assessment-density strata without selecting successful strata.
complete_scope.baseline: Training-prior ordinal predictor; causal EEG spectral/entropy ordinal regression; a train-only random forest aligned with the published feature-family baseline. Specialist tools may compute audited causal pEEG features or return train-only model predictions from the identical input window.
complete_scope.scorer: Primary participant-macro ranked probability score for the authenticated ordered categories; report ordinal MAE, per-category recall, calibration, coverage/missingness and participant-cluster paired uncertainty. Any binary SoC analysis is a separately labelled secondary target, not a substitute for missing MOAA/S labels.
negative_controls: Procedure-time/dose-only comparators outside the neural-only main score to reveal clinical-schedule shortcuts.
Audit pEEG filters/windows for future EEG leakage and embedded target/clinical columns.
EEG channel/temporal-shuffle controls with patient grouping preserved.
Report performance by artifact burden and assessment density; never claim general continuous monitoring accuracy from selectively sampled bedside assessments.

protected_split: Group by authentic person identity across all repeated recordings/procedures. Do not equate171 recordings with171 independent people. Use outer grouped folds with all temporally overlapping windows in one group, inner group tuning, and report procedure type/assessment-density strata without selecting successful strata.
scoring: Primary participant-macro ranked probability score for the authenticated ordered categories; report ordinal MAE, per-category recall, calibration, coverage/missingness and participant-cluster paired uncertainty. Any binary SoC analysis is a separately labelled secondary target, not a substitute for missing MOAA/S labels.
comparators: Training-prior ordinal predictor; causal EEG spectral/entropy ordinal regression; a train-only random forest aligned with the published feature-family baseline. Specialist tools may compute audited causal pEEG features or return train-only model predictions from the identical input window.
negative_controls: Procedure-time/dose-only comparators outside the neural-only main score to reveal clinical-schedule shortcuts.
Audit pEEG filters/windows for future EEG leakage and embedded target/clinical columns.
EEG channel/temporal-shuffle controls with patient grouping preserved.
Report performance by artifact burden and assessment density; never claim general continuous monitoring accuracy from selectively sampled bedside assessments.

paired_access_conditions.direct: No-tools inference on the complete canonical signal packet and target-free permitted context.
paired_access_conditions.numerical: Numerical tools on the identical packet. Frozen-program versus per-case adaptive tool use is separately logged within this task.
paired_access_conditions.specialist: Audited fixed feature extractor or train-only physiological model on identical information; trained model access is an assistance condition, not evidence of unaided understanding.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Same case IDs, inputs, units, masks, training/calibration exposure, protected answers, and transform support. Raw versus lossy derived signals are separately labelled input substrates; no equivalence assumed. Richer-input specialists are auxiliary.
paired_access_conditions.interpretation: Association, tool use, public exposure and physiological understanding remain separate. No model campaign is selected.

clinical_null_common_policy.direct_no_tools: A general LLM receives the complete canonical per-case neural packet and the same prespecified training-derived reference information as the other arms, without code execution, external search or specialist calls.
clinical_null_common_policy.numerical: The same model receives the identical packet and reference information plus sandboxed numerical/Python tools. Training and tuning use only outer-training groups.
clinical_null_common_policy.specialist_assisted: The same packet and numerical tools plus frozen specialist feature extractors or predictors trained/tuned only in outer-training groups; returned predictions/features must use only that packet and the explicitly matched training evidence.
clinical_null_common_policy.evidence_parity: All main comparison arms use byte-identical canonical packets, target-free metadata, the same group splits and training evidence. Raw-waveform and derived-feature variants are separate information-substrate analyses, never relabelled as a pure tool effect.
clinical_null_common_policy.full_scope: Every released participant, recording, eligible condition and prespecified evaluation window is accounted for. Unsupported labels, ambiguous timing, missing channels, artifact exclusions and context-overflow cases remain in coverage and failure reports; no successful subset becomes the benchmark.
clinical_null_common_policy.frozen_evaluation: Prespecify labels, windows, preprocessing, splits and metric before any model outcomes. Fit transforms and hyperparameters within training groups. Protected target rows, test labels, annotation-bearing code and answer-derived features cannot be participant inputs.
clinical_null_common_policy.uncertainty: Report group-level scores and paired group differences; bootstrap or other intervals must respect participants and repeated recordings. Small cohorts require prominent fold-by-fold results and limited precision.
clinical_null_common_policy.scope_of_claim: This evaluates interpretation of a specified neural representation. Behavioral responsiveness is not proof of consciousness; stimulation metadata is not a newly measured causal-connection label; symptom recognition is not a treatment recommendation.

execution_modes.direct_no_tools: The model predicts directly from each complete common packet without writing or executing a prediction program. It is not a program-writing condition.
execution_modes.frozen_program: Within each numerical-only or specialist-assisted arm, the LLM develops one prediction program using outer-training groups only. Freeze its source/configuration before protected evaluation. Execute that fixed program on every held-out case without per-case agent intervention or post-freeze tuning. Data-dependent computation inside the frozen program remains allowed by the prespecified rules.
execution_modes.case_adaptive_agent: Within each numerical-only or specialist-assisted arm, the LLM may choose analyses, write code and call permitted tools while investigating one held-out input case. Target labels remain protected; no case-derived state or fitted updates carry into other held-out cases unless a separate causal online protocol was prospectively declared.
execution_modes.comparison: Cross frozen-program versus case-adaptive execution with numerical-only versus specialist assistance. Use identical packets, training evidence, group folds and declared compute/tool budgets, and report one-time program-development cost separately from per-case cost. These are conditions of each candidate benchmark, not additional benchmark counts.

evaluator_owned_pairing_controls.purpose: Descriptive signal-pairing dependence checks. A change in prediction loss does not establish causality, a calibrated randomization test or exchangeability. No permutation p-value is reported without an independently justified prospective exchangeability model.
evaluator_owned_pairing_controls.custody_and_parity: The evaluator freezes target-free nuisance strata, admissibility rules, seeds/lags and mapping manifests before model outcomes. Targets, recipient case context and annotations stay fixed. Every arm receives the same transformed packet bytes, case order, masks and support status for each transform. Donor identities, protected labels and mappings that reveal answers stay evaluator-only. Training references, fitted transforms and models remain frozen under the original outer-fold rules.
evaluator_owned_pairing_controls.original_full_scope: The primary evaluation still scores the full original case census and reports all original missing, ambiguous or failed cases. An unavailable null never removes a case, participant, channel, condition or session from that primary evaluation. Null packets are additional diagnostics; unsupported cases retain explicit records and are not silently filled with unchanged inputs.
evaluator_owned_pairing_controls.support_and_aggregation: For every transform, publish counts and reasons for valid, invalid and unsupported mappings by participant/session and declared nuisance stratum, plus descriptive target-class coverage after maps are frozen. Compare original and transformed losses on exactly the same supported case IDs within each participant; average those paired case differences within participant, then equally across participants with support. Label this explicitly as a support-limited diagnostic, list every participant without support and retain the separate full-cohort original score. Report each transform, actual distinct-transform count and, if aggregated across transforms, equal-weight the valid transform-level paired differences; do not pool windows or hide differing coverage. No supported-case diagnostic replaces the natural-coverage primary score.
evaluator_owned_pairing_controls.invalid_policy: No identity transform counted as a null, outcome-driven retries, post-hoc stratum relaxation, cross-group donors, target-driven map selection, invented channels, altered repetition counts, synthetic boundary joins or unequal arm coverage. Prediction failures use the same frozen scorer policy as the original evaluation. If no valid transformation exists, report the null unavailable and its exact reason.

paper.title: Towards Predicting Sedation Depth in Endoscopy with Large Clinically Annotated EEG Data of Continuous Propofol Sedation
paper.qualification_note: Author project identifies AIME2026 work and a2026 technical report. Indexed Zenodo citation text gives2027 for the book chapter. Resolve bibliographic status before a publication claim; do not label the technical report a peer-reviewed clinical validation.

data.version: Fixed Zenodo record22145442 identified; exact version label and file manifest not inspected.
data.licence: Not verified in this bounded metadata pass; acquisition/redistribution remains held.
data.extent: 171 recordings /78.5 hours reported; unique-person count and repeat-procedure mapping remain unverified.
data.annotation_counts: 7,328 bedside MOAA/S assessments and1,129 annotated state-of-consciousness transitions reported by authors; these are reported metadata, not an inspected label census.

official_code.status: Author page links its GitHub repository, but the exact resolved repository URL, immutable commit and license were not retrieved within the metadata envelope.
official_code.available_functionality_reported: Author project describes pEEG feature extraction and consciousness-state classifiers; no code body or trained weights inspected.

observed_facts.claim: Author documentation describes two EEG channels sampled at125Hz during propofol endoscopy sedation, with repeated bedside responsiveness labels and additional biosignals.
The fixed Zenodo record reports40 precomputed pEEG parameters at1Hz, artifact metadata and subject/recording covariates.

The author project reports a random-forest SoC classifier result, but its validation grouping and information inputs have not been audited here; it is not a comparator score for the proposed protocol.

resources_and_remaining_gates.planning: For a complete30-second case, direct input is7,500 EEG values before masks/formatting, so context feasibility must be measured. Streaming CPU feature extraction and small ordinal/RF baselines are plausible without a GPU; archive storage and peak RAM remain unmeasured. Repeated windows may be referenced rather than duplicated. A full LLM campaign could be large and is not selected.
must_resolve: Exact data license, fixed record/version, content hashes and resolved official code repository/commit/license.
Authentic unique-person mapping and all171 recording/assessment joins.
Released MOAA/S category definitions, assessment timestamps, repeated/missing ratings and event-driven ascertainment bias.
Causal lookback/centering of each pEEG feature and artifact estimator; official code may use evidence outside a30-second packet.

Parent/root supplied an exact existing-family check: DOI10.1038/s41467-024-53299-x uses regional fMRI ISD on Figshare26367193 datasets3–5, not DOSE-I EEG. No direct source match identified; authentic upstream recording identities remain a final intake gate.
Do not replace this public clinical endpoint with the separate DOSE-I forecasting challenge or its registration-only auxiliary states.

distinctness: Clinical propofol responsiveness on repeated bedside measurements, distinct from sleep staging and the existing regional-fMRI anesthesia family; no direct source match found by the supplied finite root check. Upstream recording identity still requires final validation.

machine_output.predictions: Ordered-category probability vector for each original MOAA/S assessment slot from its complete preceding30s two-channel125Hz EEG; incomplete cases typed, not replaced.
machine_output.score_rows: For authenticatedK ordered categories, RPS=sum overk=1..K−1 of(predictedCDF(k)−indicator(y≤k))²/(K−1), averaged within person then equally across people. Scale/category mapping and numerical policies must be bound before execution; report ordinalMAE/calibration/coverage.
machine_output.coverage: Reconcile171recordings/7328assessment slots/1129reportedtransitions and all repeated-procedure person IDs. No forward-filled targets or assumption171independentpeople.

primary.name: Normalized ranked probability score, participant macro
primary.aggregation: For five-category probabilities sum four squared cumulative errors and divide by 4; average evaluable assessments within each biological person then equally across people. If any person has no evaluable assessment the full-person primary is undefined.
primary.rationale: Uses order and probabilistic uncertainty while preventing dense clinical assessment schedules from dominating.

secondary: Participant-macro ordinal MAE using prospectively fixed lower probability median; category recall uses the same decision.
Fixed-bin classwise reliability/ECE with equal-person weighting, support counts and no claim that ECE certifies calibration.
Paired original-arm RPS/MAE differences and separately support-matched transformed-packet diagnostics.

evaluation.uncertainty: Secondary implementation offers fixed-prediction biological-person paired bootstrap. It is conditional descriptive uncertainty with shared cross-fit training dependence, not validated new-patient/refitting confidence. Native person identity is a prerequisite.
evaluation.failure_policy: All 7,328 slots required; evaluable cases need exact normalized five-category decimal probabilities, nonevaluable cases explicit null. Any missing failed evaluable prediction refuses aggregate; no target access before complete arm admission.
